about: Prover tiers of the obligation loop (plan A5), cheapest first; route.py reads name and max_attempts, tools/oblig/dispatch_kernel.py the rest. `agent` is the bundled agent a wave spawns (null: no model); `model` is the model the agent must resolve to (checked against the session's resolvedModel after each answer); `override`, when set, is the session value of task.agentModelOverrides for that agent during the wave (set_tier_override writes it), because a per-call model conflicts with the project's agentModelOverrides. `mechanical` is CONTROL_TACTIC of tools/residuals/residual_package.py. `max_prompt_bytes` is the prompt bound of every goal class without its own bound; a class's `max_prompt_bytes` in routing.json replaces it, capped by the tier's `max_class_prompt_bytes` (replay.prompt_bound). sonnet-medium stays out until the replay's 50% rule (routing.json haiku_union) asks for it. `check_tool` (default false) gives each prover of the tier the kernel tool check_proof (tools/oblig/drive.py ProofProbe: a compile of its one goal in a scratch dir, the error clipped to CHECK_ERROR_BYTES), at most `check_calls` calls per attempt (default 6). Prover tools (tools/oblig/drive.py, drive_kernel.py): `check_tool` with `check_calls` gives check_proof; `lookup_calls` gives lookup and search (one budget); `counterexample_calls` gives check_counterexample, and with it a `false` answer needs a confirmed counterexample; `samples` is N of a best-of-N round (a class's routing.json `samples` replaces it; route.py counts a round as one attempt). `cost_weight` is a PLACEHOLDER relative price per token (haiku-low 1) for report.py's cost-weighted tokens per closed goal: replace these numbers with real prices.
